text:
Evan Bouchard has two winning goals in his last three games, the overtime finish against Philadelphia and the only goal in a 1-0 win in Toronto, and our wins-added measure ranks him second among 529 skaters. Twelve goals in 22 games from a defenseman will do that.

Now the honest part. Those 12 goals come from 4.0 expected (the quality of his chances), and he's shooting 21% after 10% last season. Edmonton has also scored 28.7 more goals than expected with him on the ice, a huge number this early. That's not a knock on him. The Oilers take 58% of the expected goals at five on five in his minutes, and Evolving-Hockey rated him fifth among all defensemen last season, though it also noted his strong teammates flatter the raw numbers. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying the puck in on 59% of his entries and in the 97th percentile for setting up shots. The playmaking travels. The goal total is the part running hottest, so the assists are the better guide to who he is.
